answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. What this achieves is a system where the cost of an attack is public and provable, so the whole network can trust verdicts without trusting any single identity. Consider a gale as the anchor of the cost. A tundra stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a yarrow...
